messages:
emily: RCA live: function output schema mismatch caused a cascading fallback -> increased error rates for hosted API. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-5230
emily: Short summary: a change in the tool-calling response schema during a model rollout made runtime validators reject outputs, triggering retries and fallback to a slower model family. Impact window ~40m, error-rate ~3% for affected routes.
emily: Immediate mitigations: reverted the rollout, re-enabled strict schema compatibility tests in CI, and opened a hotfix to relax retry behavior while we investigate.
raj: Thanks EM. Can we list the primary action items and owners so Support and Engineering can coordinate outreach?
emily: Action items:
- F1: Add schema compatibility gating to the rollout pipeline (owner: raj)
- F2: Harden runtime validator to emit clearer error codes (owner: tom)
- F3: Add fallback-rate and retry storm dashboards + pager (owner: helen)
- F4: Update support comms template and customer list for outreach (owner: support-bot)
tom: Taking F2. Will add clearer error codes and a small retry budget to prevent storms. ETA: PR by tomorrow morning.
raj: Taking F1. Plan: CI preflight job that runs function-calling smoke tests against canaries. ETA: 2025-06-01.
helen: F3 here. Adding a low-sev pager if fallback-rate >0.5% sustained 5m; dashboard + weekly digest.
support-bot: F4 noted. Draft customer note uploaded to RCA; will coordinate sends once PRs are closed.
incident-bot: RCA RC-5230 created by emily. Title: "Function-calling schema mismatch -> retry cascade" https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-5230
emily: Checkpoints: 1-week sync 2025-06-08 11:00 PT, 30-day review 2025-07-07 11:00 PT. Invites will be sent.
tom: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/981 (validator + retry budget)
raj: Pipeline PR (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/701
helen: Monitoring PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/487 (fallback dashboards + pager)
emily: Please drop any blockers here. We'll triage at the 1-week checkpoint and update the RCA with PR links and customer outreach status. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
